minor.issue: AI order summary does not include an explicit 'Subtotal' line (shows line items + 'delivery fee' + 'Total' only). Review request expected 'subtotal 1420 + delivery 150'. Math is correct (2*650+120=1420 subtotal, +150 delivery = 1570 total) but the subtotal line is absent from the customer-facing reply. Minor UX/spec deviation only.

For demo-pizza-palace the config returns provider='baileys', status='disconnected' (connected_number is 'Simulator' string only). Review request expected 'simulator connected'. This is state left over from earlier admin tests that switched providers — the seed on startup does NOT re-normalize the demo tenant back to simulator/connected. Not a code bug per se, but seed is not idempotent for whatsapp_config.

issues: Active provider card shows 'Baileys' selected with 'disconnected' badge for the demo tenant instead of the seeded Simulator. If seed is meant to keep demo on simulator-connected, the UI reflects the underlying seed drift noted above.
